name: 0 · APS Viewer Capabilities
for: Everyone: what the APS viewer does, in 3D and 2D
summary: Find and isolate walls, framing, doors or MEP; color by any property; cut, explode, walk and measure; the plan beside the model with areas and markups; saved views, screenshots and the full capability list.

name: 1 · Wall Type & Fire-Rating Explorer
summary: Colors every wall by wall type or fire rating, in 3D and on the plan, level by level, with a count for each.

name: 2 · Framing & Finish Takeoff
summary: Studs, track, headers, sills and cripples by mark and cut length, plus board and finish, with the walls colored by stud size.

name: 3 · Install Progress Tracker
summary: Mark walls Framed, Boarded, Taped or Finished and see progress by level in color, in 3D and on the plan, next to the P6 schedule as a Gantt chart and a calendar.

name: 4 · Field QC / Punch
for: Foremen and QC, on an iPad
summary: Big buttons and large text: stamp a punch item on the plan or in 3D, take photos with the iPad, set who fixes it, open / in review / closed. A daily or weekly PDF report with plans, stamps and photos, sent from the share sheet; progress colors on demand.

name: 5 · Field Layout Tablet Viewer
summary: Big touch buttons: pick a level to cut the model and open its plans, and measure in fractional inches.

name: 6 · Framing Shop Drawings
summary: Pick a wall to see it framed in elevation with every member tagged and its context, then print its 11x17 shop drawing.

name: 7 · Panel Tracker
summary: Each prefab panel from BIM review to framing complete: scan its QR code, type its mark or click its wall to record a step. The walls in 3D and on the plan in the color of their step, late panels flagged, the list to Excel, QR labels, and an exchange file for Revit.

name: 8 · Panel Shipper
summary: A concept: one floor's framed panels packed on as few trucks as they go, what each truck carries against its trailer, and the order to load it. Change the plan by drag and drop; the truck beside the floor plan in each truck's color.
